about: DPS too soon (follower flagged early): a 2-ghoul Stratholme pack (snapshot tr-20260922-190510-14#6) forced through the Advanced drag. At aggroConfirmed one ghoul is turned onto the frost mage at camp, so a follower is combat-flagged before the tank's fight has started. DungeonClearMath::ShouldReleaseFollower releases any follower already in combat (alreadyInCombat) and any follower when the leader has no combat stamp yet (combatSinceMs == 0), and the party-combat latch arms assist off any member's flag; the passive camp hold is the only thing left between the rest of the party and the ghoul. The injection is the sweep point, so `sweep=all` maps which holding windows leak. Plague Ghoul 53290 (a waypoint patroller spawned 7yd from the start) is not kept: it engaged the party during staging/settling, so the target ghouls were already at 70% and in combat at t=0 (lb-20261003-155828-1 run -19).

expect.knownFailure: open:DungeonClearMath::ShouldReleaseFollower alreadyInCombat / combatSinceMs==0 bypass (plan §1 class 9, flag-to-first-combat-tick gap)
